Sandbox_HighBeams_DistanceMultiplier_too: High beam distance relative to each headlight's normal distance. Range: 1-10. Default: 2.
Sandbox_HighBeams_BrightnessMultiplier_t: High beam brightness relative to each headlight's normal brightness. Range: 1-5. Default: 1.5.
Sandbox_HighBeams_Debug_tooltip: Enable execution logs for High Beams to help diagnose bugs. Disabled by default.
